scope.summary: Verify merged PoseKit receipts and package immutable two-dimensional PoseEvidencePackage records without claiming 3D pose, camera, contact, or character authority.
acceptance_criteria: Ingests only hsk.atelier.posekit.openpose_export_receipt@1 from the merged-main fixture set and emits hsk.tailor.pose_evidence_package@1; it does not emit PoseLiftProposal or mutate BodyPose authority.

Verifies receipt manifest/payload hash, PNG and JSON child manifest/payload hashes, ordered content-hash basis, JSON handshake_schema, source_ref, optional rig_id, exact package lineage, detector/model provenance, and cancellation state before packaging.

Validates fixed 768x768 evidence, BODY18/FACE70/HAND21 flattened finite x/y/confidence triples, confidence range, layer flags, marker payload, and framing payload; pixels and lens metadata remain uncalibrated 2D evidence.

Character-bound evidence dereferences rig_id to exact character/source/rig/detector provenance. Unbound reference evidence is allowed but cannot link back, derive a character-specific proposal, or auto-apply until an explicit MT-710 binding exists.
The immutable package hash follows the MT-710 canonical hash law and preserves all source hashes needed to reproduce verification without rereading a dirty worktree.

The immutable semantic payload is stored content-addressed in ArtifactStore and linked to an EventLedger event; interlink/store.rs persists only the typed authoritative ref plus transactional idempotency/query/outbox state, and list/get/replay reverify schema/content/source hashes without rerunning a model.
scope.risk_if_missed: Treating a 2D sidecar or loosely associated rig id as 3D or character authority can create confident but wrong pose applications.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-UI scope: behavior is observable through typed Tailor state, receipts, captures, diagnostics, and TraceProjection; the owning native-shell MT verifies GUI projection.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > PoseKit and character-sheet interlinking

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT emits typed diagnostics through its owning command or job and inherits retention, health, and projection behavior from the shared diagnostics substrate.
The owning native shell or scheduled job supplies Palmistry coverage; this MT must preserve operation identity and recovery handles.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.

requirements: Resolve Principal, AuthenticatedSession and AccessSpace before every resource read or mutation.
Use PostgreSQL RLS/FORCE RLS and ResourceBroker-backed artifact/file handles; UI filtering is never the security boundary.
Derived resources preserve the intersection of source access scopes and must not leak existence through counts, search, previews, logs, traces, caches, diagnostics, exports or model context.
